### Create Custom Field
POST /locations/{locationId}/customFields
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/locations/{locationId}/customFields
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/create-custom-field | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/create-custom-field.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: locations/customFields.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCustomFieldsDTO:
- name* string (e.g. "Custom Field")
- dataType* string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | FLOAT | TIME | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | SIGNATURE | RADIO | URL | DATE_TIME | USER | RICH_TEXT; e.g. "TEXT") - Data type of the custom field. URL, USER, TIME, DATE_TIME and RICH_TEXT are Labs-only for now.
- placeholder string (e.g. "Placeholder Text")
- acceptedFormat string[] (e.g. [".pdf",".docx",".jpeg"])
- isMultipleFile boolean
- maxNumberOfFiles number (e.g. 2)
- textBoxListOptions (object | object)[]
  - option 1 textBoxListOptionsSchema: object
    - label string (e.g. "First")
    - prefillValue string (e.g. "")
  - option 2 textBoxListOptionsSchema: object
    - label string (e.g. "First")
    - prefillValue string (e.g. "")
- position number (default: 0)
- model string (enum: contact | opportunity; e.g. "opportunity") - Model of the custom field you want to create
- urlValidation object - URL validation rules. Required when dataType is URL.
  - mode string (enum: allow_all | allow_only | block; e.g. "allow_all") - allow_all: any url. allow_only: only allowedDomains. block: anything but blockedDomains.
  - allowedDomains string[] (e.g. ["example.com"]) - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
  - blockedDomains string[] (e.g. []) - Domains rejected when mode is block
- dateTimeValidation object - Date/time validation. Required for TIME and DATE_TIME; optional for DATE when using validation rules.
  - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range; e.g. "any") - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
  - bufferDays number (e.g. 2) - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
  - rollingDays number (e.g. 30) - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
  - rangeMin string (e.g. "2026-01-01") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - rangeMax string (e.g. "2026-12-31") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - daysAllowed number[] (e.g. [1,2,3,4,5]) - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
  - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time; e.g. "date_and_time") - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
- userFieldConfig object - User field options. Required when dataType is USER. multiSelect cannot be changed after create.
  - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
- optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE; e.g. "TEXT_WITH_IMAGE") - Option rendering mode for RADIO / CHECKBOX. One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE. Defaults to TEXT_ONLY.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- customField object
  - id string
  - name string
  - fieldKey string
  - placeholder string
  - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | FLOAT | TIME | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | SIGNATURE | RADIO | URL | DATE_TIME | USER | RICH_TEXT) - Data type of the custom field. URL, USER, TIME, DATE_TIME and RICH_TEXT are Labs-only for now.
  - position number
  - picklistOptions string[]
  - picklistImageOptions string[]
  - isAllowedCustomOption boolean
  - isMultiFileAllowed boolean
  - maxFileLimit number
  - locationId string
  - model string (enum: contact | opportunity) - Model of the custom field
  - urlValidation object - URL validation (URL fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: allow_all | allow_only | block) - allow_all: any url. allow_only: only allowedDomains. block: anything but blockedDomains.
    - allowedDomains string[] - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
    - blockedDomains string[] - Domains rejected when mode is block
  - dateTimeValidation object - Date/time validation (DATE, TIME, DATE_TIME). DATE_TIME and TIME are Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range) - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
    - bufferDays number - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
    - rollingDays number - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
    - rangeMin string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - rangeMax string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - daysAllowed number[] - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
    - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time) - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
  - userFieldConfig object - User field config (USER fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
  - optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE) - Option rendering mode for RADIO / CHECKBOX. One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE.

### Create Recurring Task
POST /locations/{locationId}/recurring-tasks
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/locations/{locationId}/recurring-tasks
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/create-recurring-task | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/create-recurring-task.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string

Request body (required) (application/json) RecurringTaskCreateDTO:
- title* string (e.g. "Task Name") - Name of the task
- description string (e.g. "Task Description") - Description of the task
- contactIds string[] (e.g. ["sx6wyHhbFdRXh302Lunr"]) - Contact Id
- owners string[] (e.g. ["sx6wyHhbFdRXh302Lunr"]) - Assigned To
- rruleOptions* object - Recurring rules
  - intervalType* string (enum: yearly | monthly | weekly | daily | hourly; e.g. "monthly")
  - interval* number (e.g. 2)
  - startDate* string (e.g. "2021-09-30T00:00:00.000Z") - Start Date
  - endDate string (e.g. "2021-09-30T00:00:00.000Z") - End Date
  - dayOfMonth number (e.g. 15) - 1, 2, 3, ..., 27, 31
  - dayOfWeek string (enum: MO | TU | WE | TH | FR | SA | SU; e.g. "MO")
  - monthOfYear number (e.g. 1) - 1, 2, ....., 11, 12
  - count number (e.g. 10) - Max number of task executions
  - createTaskIfOverDue boolean - Create Task If Over Due
  - dueAfterSeconds* number (e.g. 23404000) - Due after seconds
- ignoreTaskCreation boolean - Create initial task or not

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- recurringTask* object - Recurring Tasks
  - id* string - Recurring Task Id
  - title* string - Name of the task
  - description* string - Description of the task
  - locationId* string - Location Id
  - updatedAt* string - Updated At
  - createdAt* string - Created At
  - rruleOptions* object - Recurring rules
    - intervalType* string (enum: yearly | monthly | weekly | daily | hourly)
    - interval* number
    - startDate* string - Start Date
    - endDate string - End Date
    - dayOfMonth number - 1, 2, 3, ..., 27, 31
    - dayOfWeek string (enum: MO | TU | WE | TH | FR | SA | SU)
    - monthOfYear number - 1, 2, ....., 11, 12
    - count number - Max number of task executions
    - createTaskIfOverDue boolean - Create Task If Over Due
    - dueAfterSeconds* number - Due after seconds
  - totalOccurrence* number - Total Occurrence
  - deleted* boolean - Deleted
  - assignedTo string - Assigned To
  - contactId string - Contact Id

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Get Custom Field
GET /locations/{locationId}/customFields/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/locations/{locationId}/customFields/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/get-custom-field | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/get-custom-field.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id
- id* string - Custom Field Id or Field Key (e.g. "contact.first_name" or "opportunity.pipeline_id")

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- customField object
  - id string
  - name string
  - fieldKey string
  - placeholder string
  - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | FLOAT | TIME | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | SIGNATURE | RADIO | URL | DATE_TIME | USER | RICH_TEXT) - Data type of the custom field. URL, USER, TIME, DATE_TIME and RICH_TEXT are Labs-only for now.
  - position number
  - picklistOptions string[]
  - picklistImageOptions string[]
  - isAllowedCustomOption boolean
  - isMultiFileAllowed boolean
  - maxFileLimit number
  - locationId string
  - model string (enum: contact | opportunity) - Model of the custom field
  - urlValidation object - URL validation (URL fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: allow_all | allow_only | block) - allow_all: any url. allow_only: only allowedDomains. block: anything but blockedDomains.
    - allowedDomains string[] - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
    - blockedDomains string[] - Domains rejected when mode is block
  - dateTimeValidation object - Date/time validation (DATE, TIME, DATE_TIME). DATE_TIME and TIME are Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range) - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
    - bufferDays number - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
    - rollingDays number - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
    - rangeMin string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - rangeMax string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - daysAllowed number[] - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
    - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time) - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
  - userFieldConfig object - User field config (USER fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
  - optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE) - Option rendering mode for RADIO / CHECKBOX. One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Search
GET /locations/search
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/locations/search
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/search-locations | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/search-locations.md

Search Sub-Account (Formerly Location)

Auth (any one of):
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: locations.readonly
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: locations.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- companyId string (e.g. "5DP4iH6HLkQsiKESj6rh") - The company/agency id on which you want to perform the search
- skip string (default: 0; e.g. "1") - The value by which the results should be skipped. Default will be 0
- limit string (default: 10) - The value by which the results should be limited. Default will be 10
- order string (default: asc) - The order in which the results should be returned - Allowed values asc, desc. Default will be asc
- email string (e.g. "johndoe@mail.com")

### Update Custom Field
PUT /locations/{locationId}/customFields/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/locations/{locationId}/customFields/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/update-custom-field | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/update-custom-field.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: none

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id
- id* string (e.g. "00NhGCcN1tlO8ZHcu7Wb") - Custom Field Id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateCustomFieldsDTO:
- name* string (e.g. "Custom Field")
- placeholder string (e.g. "Placeholder Text")
- acceptedFormat string[] (e.g. [".pdf",".docx",".jpeg"])
- isMultipleFile boolean
- maxNumberOfFiles number (e.g. 2)
- textBoxListOptions (object | object)[]
  - option 1 textBoxListOptionsSchema: object
    - label string (e.g. "First")
    - prefillValue string (e.g. "")
  - option 2 textBoxListOptionsSchema: object
    - label string (e.g. "First")
    - prefillValue string (e.g. "")
- position number (default: 0)
- model string (enum: contact | opportunity; e.g. "opportunity") - Model of the custom field you want to update
- urlValidation object - When provided, replaces URL validation rules (URL fields only).
  - mode string (enum: allow_all | allow_only | block; e.g. "allow_all") - allow_all: any url. allow_only: only allowedDomains. block: anything but blockedDomains.
  - allowedDomains string[] (e.g. ["example.com"]) - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
  - blockedDomains string[] (e.g. []) - Domains rejected when mode is block
- dateTimeValidation object - When provided, replaces date/time validation rules (DATE, TIME, DATE_TIME fields only).
  - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range; e.g. "any") - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
  - bufferDays number (e.g. 2) - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
  - rollingDays number (e.g. 30) - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
  - rangeMin string (e.g. "2026-01-01") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - rangeMax string (e.g. "2026-12-31") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - daysAllowed number[] (e.g. [1,2,3,4,5]) - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
  - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time; e.g. "date_and_time") - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
- userFieldConfig object - When provided, updates user field options except multiSelect (immutable after create).
  - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
- optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE; e.g. "TEXT_WITH_IMAGE") - When provided, updates the option rendering mode (RADIO / CHECKBOX only). One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- customField object
  - id string
  - name string
  - fieldKey string
  - placeholder string
  - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | FLOAT | TIME | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | SIGNATURE | RADIO | URL | DATE_TIME | USER | RICH_TEXT) - Data type of the custom field. URL, USER, TIME, DATE_TIME and RICH_TEXT are Labs-only for now.
  - position number
  - picklistOptions string[]
  - picklistImageOptions string[]
  - isAllowedCustomOption boolean
  - isMultiFileAllowed boolean
  - maxFileLimit number
  - locationId string
  - model string (enum: contact | opportunity) - Model of the custom field
  - urlValidation object - URL validation (URL fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: allow_all | allow_only | block) - allow_all: any url. allow_only: only allowedDomains. block: anything but blockedDomains.
    - allowedDomains string[] - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
    - blockedDomains string[] - Domains rejected when mode is block
  - dateTimeValidation object - Date/time validation (DATE, TIME, DATE_TIME). DATE_TIME and TIME are Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range) - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
    - bufferDays number - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
    - rollingDays number - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
    - rangeMin string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - rangeMax string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - daysAllowed number[] - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
    - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time) - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
  - userFieldConfig object - User field config (USER fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
  - optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE) - Option rendering mode for RADIO / CHECKBOX. One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
